title: When the Orchard Falls
author: Marguerite Coldharbour
blurb: Jude Ravensworth, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
